Team — quick runway note before EOD submission: please block 15 minutes on your calendars for a short "safety check" to verify stage accuracy, evidence links, and any pricing/term blockers for top-close accounts. Goal is to avoid last-minute reopens during submission.

Agenda (15m):
- 0:00–0:03 — Rapid stage confirm (Are deals in final stage reflecting current close intent?)
- 0:03–0:08 — Evidence sanity check (attachments, links, SOC/contract asks)
- 0:08–0:12 — Risk flags & mitigation owner (procurement, legal, pricing)
- 0:12–0:15 — Quick roll (who will submit / exceptions)

Top accounts I want pulled up during the call (please update the spreadsheet):
- Acme Analytics (DEAL-4821) — confirm final term sheet & T&C acceptance
- Northwind Insights — confirm renewal discount applied
- Bluebird Labs — verify SOC2 evidence attached

Action items before the check-in (by 12:00 PT):
- Update stage to the most conservative "Commit" flag you can defend in case of audit (Marissa: Acme row)
- Drop final evidence link in the Q2-pipeline-hygiene.xlsx (see tab "evidence")
- Flag any procurement/legal holds in this thread (Irene)

Attachments: Q2-pipeline-hygiene.xlsx (spreadsheet), Acme-MAPL-term-sheet.pdf (term-sheet stub).

If you can't make the 15m, respond with your owner & who will speak for you. I will run the call at 12:30 PT today.

—Sofia
